function: Jointly learns UAV trajectory, RIS phase shifts and HAP active transmit beamforming to maximize energy efficiency (ergodic sum rate over UAV energy), p. 10.
system: HAP with N_H-antenna ULA serves K single-antenna IoT devices through a UAV-mounted reflecting RIS (M=16-128 elements); GEO satellite-HAP FSO link, 2 GHz RF band, pp. 4, 11.
method: Reinforcement learning: double DQN with LSTM layer and prioritized experience replay; CNN encoder, fully connected layer, LSTM, fully connected Q-value output, pp. 9-10.
data_channel: No dataset: channels randomly generated in a custom simulator (Gamma-Gamma FSO link, Nakagami-m HAP-user link, Rician HAP-RIS and RIS-user links) for training and testing, pp. 5-6, 11.
test_conditions: Training and testing in the same simulated environment (online RL, curves over episodes); sweeps over RIS elements 16-128 and HAP transmit power; no unseen scenario, pp. 12-13.
baselines: Random RIS phase shift (non-learned); traditional DDQN, i.e., proposed method without LSTM; NOMA versus OMA variants of both agents; no earlier published method simulated, pp. 12-13.
metrics: Ergodic sum rate (Mbps), reward (energy efficiency), energy efficiency versus number of RIS elements, 3D UAV trajectory, episodes to converge, pp. 12-13.
complexity: Order O(Io(KL)) in complex multiplications for K devices and L agents, versus O(Io(K log K)) genetic-search RL and exhaustive search; no runtime, p. 11.
openness: none; PyTorch used for implementation but no code or data link, p. 11.
q1_support: p. 11: "we randomly generate the channel model presented in the previous section"; p. 5: "the HAP-to-ground channel is modeled by Nakagami-m fading". Custom Gamma-Gamma, Nakagami and Rician simulator; no 3GPP, QuaDRiGa, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 13: "When the number of RIS elements is increased from M = 16 to M = 32, the energy efficiency performance improvement is not significant". Only sweeps of RIS elements and HAP power; no model trained in one scenario and tested in another.
q3_support: p. 12: "the traditional DDQN scheme, independent of any influence from historical information"; p. 13: "we introduce the random RIS phase shift case". Random phase shift is a non-learned baseline, but the only learned baseline is the proposed method without its LSTM (ablation); no earlier published learned method is simulated.
q4_support: p. 11: "the computational complexity is determined to be O (Io (KL))", compared with genetic-search RL and exhaustive search complexities.
q5_support: p. 11: "we utilized the PyTorch package as the primary tool for implementation" and "we first randomly generate the channel vector matrix". No code or data link or DOI; channels are simulated.
notes: Included: LSTM-DDQN learns RIS phase shifts and HAP beamforming jointly with UAV trajectory (p. 10), so above_phy does not apply. Area 6 chosen over 3 by the tie-break order (satellite-HAP-UAV RIS link). q3 is borderline: DDQN baseline is the proposed method without LSTM/PER (ablation), so marked 0; reviewer may reconsider.
